expr: (() => { const b = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => /sign in|log in|submit/i.test(x.textContent || '')); if (!b) return 'no button'; b.click(); return 'clicked'; })()
(() => { const t = document.body.innerText || ''; return 'path=' + location.pathname + ';shell=' + (t.includes('Dashboard') && t.includes('Modules')); })()

(() => { const t = document.body.innerText; const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(x => (x.textContent||'').includes('Probe')); const cs = btn ? getComputedStyle(btn) : null; const theme = document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme'); const font = getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily; return 'edge=' + t.includes('edge-sim') + ';dark=' + t.includes('dark-site') + ';upBadges=' + (t.match(/UP/g)||[]).length + ';downBadges=' + (t.match(/DOWN/g)||[]).length + ';btnCursor=' + (cs ? cs.cursor : 'n/a') + ';theme=' + theme + ';fontHasGeist=' + font.includes('Geist') + ';tabular=' + (getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('.stat-value')).fontVariantNumeric || 'n/a'); })()
